 vertebral artery which ended in a PICA.   At this point the procedure was
 aborted and the patient was taken back to the ICU neurologically unchanged.

 right internal carotid artery and its branches.  The right external carotid
 artery and its branches fill well.  Right subclavian artery arteriogram shows
